content.value: A monstrous mecha-android built specifically to house the Thatcher Steel CEO. A reinforced glass cockpit reveals her emaciated body, allowing her worshippers to look upon her terrible visage. Sustained far beyond her mortal years, she requires only 4 hours sleep.

The Iron Lady can take one of three Titanic Actions at a time, detailed below. These can only be chosen at the end of another Pilot's or NPC's turn. She regains spent Titanic Actions at the start of her turn.
The Iron Lady moves one Range Band.
The Iron Lady makes a single Iron Claw attack.
The Iron Lady makes a M.I.L.K Spray attack (costs 2 Titanic Actions).
The Iron Lady is equipped with the following standard Mech Modules, which may be used per their standard rules: Comms Module, IR Night Vision, Firewall.
